verses.text: He began to teach again by the sea. And such a very large crowd gathered to Him that He got into a boat in the sea and sat down; and the whole crowd was by the sea on the land.
verses.textZh: 耶穌又在海邊教訓人。有許多人到他那裡聚集，他只得上船坐下。船在海裡，眾人都靠近海，站在岸上。

verses.text: And He was teaching them many things in parables, and was saying to them in His teaching,
verses.textZh: 耶穌就用比喻教訓他們許多道理。在教訓之間，對他們說：

verses.text: 'Listen [to this]! Behold, the sower went out to sow;
verses.textZh: 你們聽阿！有一個撒種的出去撒種。

verses.text: as he was sowing, some [seed] fell beside the road, and the birds came and ate it up.
verses.textZh: 撒的時候，有落在路旁的，飛鳥來吃盡了；

verses.text: 'Other [seed] fell on the rocky [ground] where it did not have much soil; and immediately it sprang up because it had no depth of soil.
verses.textZh: 有落在土淺石頭地上的，土既不深，發苗最快，

verses.text: 'And after the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
verses.textZh: 日頭出來一曬，因為沒有根，就枯乾了；

verses.text: 'Other [seed] fell among the thorns, and the thorns came up and choked it, and it yielded no crop.
verses.textZh: 有落在荊棘裡的，荊棘長起來，把他擠住了，就不結實；

verses.text: 'Other [seeds] fell into the good soil, and as they grew up and increased, they yielded a crop and produced thirty, sixty, and a hundredfold.'
verses.textZh: 又有落在好土裡的，就發生長大，結實有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的；

verses.text: And He was saying, 'He who has ears to hear, let him hear.'
verses.textZh: 又說：有耳可聽的，就應當聽！

verses.text: As soon as He was alone, His followers, along with the twelve, [began] asking Him [about] the parables.
verses.textZh: 無人的時候，跟隨耶穌的人和十二個門徒問他這比喻的意思。

verses.text: And He was saying to them, 'To you has been given the mystery of the kingdom of God, but those who are outside get everything in parables,
verses.textZh: 耶穌對他們說：神國的奧祕只叫你們知道，若是對外人講，凡事就用比喻，

verses.text: so that WHILE SEEING, THEY MAY SEE AND NOT PERCEIVE, AND WHILE HEARING, THEY MAY HEAR AND NOT UNDERSTAND, OTHERWISE THEY MIGHT RETURN AND BE FORGIVEN.'
verses.textZh: 叫他們看是看見，卻不曉得；聽是聽見，卻不明白；恐怕他們回轉過來，就得赦免。

verses.text: And He said to them, 'Do you not understand this parable? How will you understand all the parables?
verses.textZh: 又對他們說：你們不明白這比喻麼？這樣怎能明白一切的比喻呢？

verses.text: 'The sower sows the word.
verses.textZh: 撒種之人所撒的就是道。

verses.text: 'These are the ones who are beside the road where the word is sown; and when they hear, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.
verses.textZh: 那撒在路旁的，就是人聽了道，撒但立刻來，把撒在他心裡的道奪了去。

verses.text: 'In a similar way these are the ones on whom seed was sown on the rocky [places], who, when they hear the word, immediately receive it with joy;
verses.textZh: 那撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，立刻歡喜領受，

verses.text: and they have no [firm] root in themselves, but are [only] temporary; then, when affliction or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they fall away.
verses.textZh: 但他心裡沒有根，不過是暫時的，及至為道遭了患難，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。

verses.text: 'And others are the ones on whom seed was sown among the thorns; these are the ones who have heard the word,
verses.textZh: 還有那撒在荊棘裡的，就是人聽了道，

verses.text: but the worries of the world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the desires for other things enter in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
verses.textZh: 後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑，和別樣的私慾進來，把道擠住了，就不能結實。

verses.text: 'And those are the ones on whom seed was sown on the good soil; and they hear the word and accept it and bear fruit, thirty, sixty, and a hundredfold.'
verses.textZh: 那撒在好地上的，就是人聽道，又領受，並且結實，有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的。

verses.text: And He was saying to them, 'A lamp is not brought to be put under a basket, is it, or under a bed? Is it not [brought] to be put on the lampstand?
verses.textZh: 耶穌又對他們說：人拿燈來，豈是要放在斗底下，床底下，不放在燈臺上麼？

verses.text: 'For nothing is hidden, except to be revealed; nor has [anything] been secret, but that it would come to light.
verses.textZh: 因為掩藏的事，沒有不顯出來的；隱瞞的事，沒有不露出來的。

verses.text: 'If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.'
verses.textZh: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！

verses.text: And He was saying to them, 'Take care what you listen to. By your standard of measure it will be measured to you; and more will be given you besides.
verses.textZh: 又說：你們所聽的要留心。你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們，並且要多給你們。

verses.text: 'For whoever has, to him [more] shall be given; and whoever does not have, even what he has shall be taken away from him.'
verses.textZh: 因為有的，還要給他；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪去。

verses.text: And He was saying, 'The kingdom of God is like a man who casts seed upon the soil;
verses.textZh: 又說：神的國如同人把種撒在地上。

verses.text: and he goes to bed at night and gets up by day, and the seed sprouts and grows-- how, he himself does not know.
verses.textZh: 黑夜睡覺，白日起來，這種就發芽漸長，那人卻不曉得如何這樣。

verses.text: 'The soil produces crops by itself; first the blade, then the head, then the mature grain in the head.
verses.textZh: 地生五穀是出於自然的：先發苗，後長穗，再後穗上結成飽滿的子粒；

verses.text: 'But when the crop permits, he immediately puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.'
verses.textZh: 穀既熟了，就用鐮刀去割，因為收成的時候到了。

verses.text: And He said, 'How shall we picture the kingdom of God, or by what parable shall we present it?
verses.textZh: 又說：神的國，我們可用甚麼比較呢？可用甚麼比喻表明呢？

verses.text: '[It is] like a mustard seed, which, when sown upon the soil, though it is smaller than all the seeds that are upon the soil,
verses.textZh: 好像一粒芥菜種，種在地裡的時候，雖比地上的百種都小，

verses.text: yet when it is sown, it grows up and becomes larger than all the garden plants and forms large branches; so that THE BIRDS OF THE AIR can NEST UNDER ITS SHADE.'
verses.textZh: 但種上以後，就長起來，比各樣的菜都大，又長出大枝來，甚至天上的飛鳥可以宿在他的蔭下。

verses.text: With many such parables He was speaking the word to them, so far as they were able to hear it;
verses.textZh: 耶穌用許多這樣的比喻，照他們所能聽的，對他們講道。

verses.text: and He did not speak to them without a parable; but He was explaining everything privately to His own disciples.
verses.textZh: 若不用比喻，就不對他們講；沒有人的時候，就把一切的道講給門徒聽。

verses.text: On that day, when evening came, He said to them, 'Let us go over to the other side.'
verses.textZh: 當那天晚上，耶穌對門徒說：我們渡到那邊去罷。

verses.text: Leaving the crowd, they took Him along with them in the boat, just as He was; and other boats were with Him.
verses.textZh: 門徒離開眾人，耶穌仍在船上，他們就把他一同帶去；也有別的船和他同行。

verses.text: And there arose a fierce gale of wind, and the waves were breaking over the boat so much that the boat was already filling up.
verses.textZh: 忽然起了暴風，波浪打入船內，甚至船要滿了水。

verses.text: Jesus Himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke Him and said to Him, 'Teacher, do You not care that we are perishing?'
verses.textZh: 耶穌在船尾上，枕著枕頭睡覺。門徒叫醒了他，說：夫子！我們喪命，你不顧麼？

verses.text: And He got up and rebuked the wind and said to the sea, 'Hush, be still.' And the wind died down and it became perfectly calm.
verses.textZh: 耶穌醒了，斥責風，向海說：住了罷！靜了罷！風就止住，大大的平靜了。

verses.text: And He said to them, 'Why are you afraid? Do you still have no faith?'
verses.textZh: 耶穌對他們說：為甚麼膽怯？你們還沒有信心麼？

verses.text: They became very much afraid and said to one another, 'Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?'
verses.textZh: 他們就大大的懼怕，彼此說：這到底是誰，連風和海也聽從他了。
